active_mass.quote: The ICARUS-T600, with a total active mass of 476 ton, is the first large-scale operating LAr-TPC detector

baseline.quote: The far detector (the improved ICARUS-T600) will be located in a new building 600 m from the BNB target.

description.quote: Along with the new Cosmic Ray Tagger it forms the far detector for the Short-Baseline Neutrino program.
description.value: cosmic ray tagger surrounding the cryostats, needed because the detector operates at shallow depth at Fermilab

summary.plain: A 760-tonne liquid argon detector, the first of its size ever built. It worked under an Italian mountain from 2010 to 2013, was rebuilt at CERN, and now sits at Fermilab as the far detector of a search for a possible fourth kind of neutrino.
summary.technical: Two adjacent 3.6 × 3.9 × 19.6 m liquid argon TPC modules holding 760 t of argon with 476 t active mass; operated in LNGS Hall B 2010-2013 on the CNGS beam, overhauled at CERN 2014-2017, and running at Fermilab as the SBN far detector 600 m from the BNB target.

technology.quote: it consists of two large and identical adjacent modules with internal dimensions 3.6 × 3.9 × 19.6 m³, filled with a total of 760 tons of ultra-pure liquid argon
technology.value: single-phase liquid argon time projection chamber in two adjacent modules
